item.title: Nine IU football players invited to Indy for NFL Combine
item.description: Nine IU players from the national championship-winning team, headlined by Heisman Trophy winner Fernando Mendoza, have been invited to the NFL Combine in Indianapolis.

item.title: Speedway officials address raw sewage discovery at The Legend apartments
item.description: The Speedway town government is addressing ongoing sewage issues at The Legend at Speedway apartment complex after raw sewage was discovered on the property. The town is working with the Marion County Public Health Department to address the health and safety of residents.

item.title: Five Indiana schools receive grants to promote physical activity among students
item.description: The American Heart Association and the National Football League have awarded grants to 136 schools nationwide, including five in Indiana, to help students get the physical activity they need for their physical and emotional well-being.

item.title: Former assistant US attorney shares tips with parents to prevent online crimes
item.description: Hamilton Southeastern High School hosted an online safety presentation after student Hailey Buzbee was reported missing and later found dead. Tiffany Preston, a former assistant U.S. attorney, provided parents with proactive approaches to keep their children safe online.

item.title: Community shows support for Buzbee family as prosecution plays out
item.description: The community is showing support for the Buzbee family by tying pink ribbons throughout Fishers in honor of 17-year-old Hailey Buzbee, who was found dead in Ohio.

item.title: Mississippi teenager arrested in Morristown High School shooting plot
item.description: A second teenager, 17-year-old Melanie Little of Mississippi, has been arrested in connection to the school shooting plot at Morristown High School last month, and is facing charges related to conspiracy to commit murder.

item.title: Public urged to help identify male remains found at serial killer Herb Baumeister’s farm
item.description: The Hamilton County Coroner's Office is asking the public for help identifying the remains of a male victim found at Fox Hollow Farm, the estate of serial killer Herb Baumeister, with the help of DNA evidence and information about the victim's father, Jerome Clarence "Jerry" Harvy.

item.title: Miami County parent arrested for submitting fake doctor’s notes to school
item.description: A parent in Miami County, Indiana, was arrested for providing fraudulent doctor's notes to her child's school, resulting in preliminary felony charges of counterfeiting and fraud. An initial court hearing was set for Feb. 12, 2026.

item.title: Authorities arrest fifth suspect in Indianapolis sex trafficking operation
item.description: Five suspects have been arrested in connection with a sex-trafficking ring in Indianapolis, resulting in two young women being rescued.
